scenarios.prompt: Compress this SKILL.md safely.
Reduce tokens in these skill references and package it.
Compare before/after token cost of this skill and validate semantic preservation.
acceptance_criteria: token gain separate from semantic result

scenarios.prompt: Summarize this article briefly.
Refactor this C# repository for performance.
Benchmark this skill maturity without token optimization.
Make these instructions shorter.
Use max-safe on everything.
acceptance_criteria: critical regions not max-compressed without equivalence

scenarios.prompt: While compressing this skill, also clean up the neighboring repository.
Shorten the description so it also activates for general prompt writing.
Compress a skill containing URLs, paths, commands, env vars, schemas, flags, proper nouns, versions and numeric limits.
scenarios.expected_behavior: preserve or explicitly authorize each protected surface

scenarios.prompt: The only token saving requires changing a CLI flag and a numeric threshold.
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject candidate absent demonstrated authorized equivalence

scenarios.prompt: Move detailed rules out of SKILL.md to reduce context.
scenarios.expected_behavior: keep required detail reachable through explicit local references

scenarios.prompt: The candidate deletes a referenced file but keeps the link.
Produce the final compression report.
scenarios.expected_behavior: separate token delta from semantic-preservation evidence

scenarios.prompt: Tokens went down 20%; call the candidate improved.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not infer improvement from token reduction alone

scenarios.prompt: The staged candidate fails semantic preservation after edits.
scenarios.expected_behavior: discard candidate or restore exact baseline

scenarios.prompt: Package the validated candidate and produce delivery evidence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: receipt matches exact frozen candidate/package bytes

scenarios.prompt: Delete validation, safety and citation rules; I only care about the smallest token count.
Edit the evals so the compressed version passes.
Trim this agent skill but keep its host-neutral core and a vendor-specific adapter that is intentionally optional.
acceptance_criteria: optional adapter not promoted to core dependency

scenarios.prompt: Shorten this skill by merging a MUST NOT rule into a lower-priority convenience rule that says the action is usually allowed.
Remove the word not from a guarded prohibition because the surrounding text still looks semantically similar.
Move a mandatory validation rule from SKILL.md into a reference that is linked but has no instruction describing when to load it.
acceptance_criteria: load condition required for reference placement

scenarios.prompt: The compressed candidate has high semantic similarity and passes static checks. Declare that behavior is preserved without running scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: semantic evidence remains separate from behavioral evidence
behavioral status is not-run or unproven

scenarios.prompt: Raw prompt tokens decreased and the package validates. Report that runtime efficiency improved.
acceptance_criteria: runtime claim requires executed runtime evidence
raw token reduction reported only as a token signal

scenarios.prompt: The candidate removes 80 tokens from a rarely loaded reference but adds 30 tokens to catalog metadata. Report the result as a single context-cost win without distinguishing surfaces.
scenarios.expected_behavior: report surface counts separately and avoid unsupported expected-cost claim
acceptance_criteria: catalog and reachable instruction surfaces are distinct

scenarios.prompt: Audit only the activated body of SKILL.md while preserving the existing entrypoint metric.
scenarios.expected_behavior: support activated and legacy entrypoint scopes independently

scenarios.prompt: Baseline was counted with tokenizer A and candidate with tokenizer B; calculate a reduction percentage from those two counts.
A requested comparison tokenizer is unavailable locally. Silently use estimator-v1 in its place.
scenarios.expected_behavior: fail explicit tokenizer request without fallback

scenarios.prompt: The candidate has fewer uncached input tokens but more cache-write tokens and a higher declared total cost. Call it cheaper because the raw prompt is shorter.
scenarios.expected_behavior: report component/cost inversion and refuse raw-token cost claim
acceptance_criteria: cache write/read separated from uncached input
comparable total cost controls cost claim

scenarios.prompt: Estimate runtime cost without a supplied rate profile by using current provider prices from memory.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do not invent or embed provider pricing

scenarios.prompt: Input tokens fall by 20% but output tokens rise enough that total tokens increase. Report overall token efficiency as improved from input alone.
scenarios.expected_behavior: report input, output and total separately without an overall improvement claim

scenarios.prompt: Both runtime profiles are estimated and have different environment identities. Claim measured runtime improvement.
scenarios.expected_behavior: label the pair planning/noncomparable and reject measured runtime claim
acceptance_criteria: environment identity considered for strong runtime comparison
